question: Can a direction-neutral synchronization/activity shock, dwell, stress-relief, and post-stress activity-impairment process be represented stably from frozen correlation/liquidity levels without rescuing the failed raw liquidity-change window?
research_role: strategy-independent process representation and volatility-redundancy falsification
usefulness_boundary: No panic, negative-direction event, price recovery, future return, reversal, strategy, habitat, or economic-usefulness claim is permitted.
forbidden_inputs: strategy membership, signal, entry, trade, fill, P&L, MFE, MAE, exit, duration, or outcome class
future returns or any observation after the completed current close
participant identity, order-flow side, unregistered sentiment/fund flow, or constituent fallback
liquidity_activity_change3, liquidity_activity_change5, or liquidity_activity_change10 as a shock representation

pit.available_at: must equal the same completed close in both frozen panels
pit.normalization: strictly causal panel coordinates including current completed observation only, minimum 504 observations
pit.episode_update: sequential past/current state only; episode peak is causal running peak, never hindsight peak
pit.missing_required_state: break episode and emit missing process coordinates
pit.first_actionable_time: later causally valid session; this experiment creates no action

population.normalized_start: first date each group has all required 504-observation causal percentiles

frozen_components.activity_neighbors: construct strictly causal 3-year percentiles for frozen ratio10 and ratio60 raw neighbors with the same minimum history

states.NORMAL: inactive or primary score below reset
states.ONSET: inactive primary score enters >= stress threshold
states.STRESS: active episode remains >= stress threshold after onset
states.RELIEF: active episode score is between reset and stress threshold

state_machine.episode_age: causal sessions since onset while active
state_machine.episode_peak: causal running maximum score while active
state_machine.activity_impairment: RELIEF and activity percentile <= impairment threshold
state_machine.reentry: return above stress threshold before reset remains the same episode and is not a new onset

coordinates.absolute: retain all frozen raw component levels
coordinates.pit: retain expanding/trailing percentiles and robust z for frozen components plus causal joint-score history
coordinates.relative: retain frozen view-minus-ALL_A and view ranks; derive same-date joint-score view-minus-ALL_A and rank
coordinates.process: state, onset, episode age, causal episode peak, relief magnitude, activity-impairment flag

gates.no_rescue: A failed primary process is not replaced by a threshold, aggregation, or activity-horizon neighbor.
